name: restful-booker-data-driven-testing
description: Production-grade Data-Driven Testing (DDT) framework for Restful Booker API using Postman, Newman CLI, CSV parametrization, and automated HTML reporting.

scripts.test:report: newman run "Restful Booker API.postman_collection.json" -e "RestfulBooker_Env.postman_environment.json" -d "Datasheet-for-DDT - Sheet1.csv" -n 5 --delay-request 300 -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export ./reports/Restful_Booker_DDT_Newman_Report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Restful Booker Data-Driven Testing (DDT) Report"

author: Tanzim Rahman (TanzimSQA)
